verification.confirmation_notes: 2026 Vermont Hunting & Trapping Seasons date sheet (VFWD, published 7/8/2025). Trapping: mink/skunk/red & gray fox/raccoon/coyote/opossum/weasel Oct 24-Dec 31, 2026; otter/muskrat/beaver Oct 24, 2026-Mar 31, 2027; fisher Dec 1-31; bobcat Dec 1-16; marten/lynx/wolf no open season. Hunting: bobcat Jan 10-Feb 7 (year unstated, read as 2026); red & gray fox Oct 24, 2026-Feb 14, 2027; raccoon Oct 10-Dec 31; muskrat Mar 20-Apr 19; weasel/skunk/opossum open year-round; fisher/otter/beaver/mink no open hunting season; coyote hunting dates not given ('check website').
